lines.pinyin: Shì de, wǒ zài jiālǐ kàn diànshì.
lines.english: Yes, I'm at home watching TV.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jiālǐ yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
lines.english: How many people are in your family?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 四口人：爸爸、妈妈、弟弟和我。
lines.pinyin: Sì kǒu rén: bàba, māma, dìdi hé wǒ.
lines.english: Four people: dad, mom, younger brother, and me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bàba māma zài jiā ma?
lines.english: Are your dad and mom at home?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 爸爸在上班，妈妈在做饭。
lines.pinyin: Bàba zài shàngbān, māma zài zuòfàn.
lines.english: Dad is at work, mom is cooking.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 晚上全家人一起吃饭吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǎnshàng quán jiārén yīqǐ chīfàn ma?
lines.english: Does the whole family eat dinner together in the evening?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 是的，我们每天晚上七点吃饭。
lines.pinyin: Shì de, wǒmen měitiān wǎnshang qī diǎn chīfàn.
lines.english: Yes, we eat dinner at 7 PM every night.
